title: SEMA-Auto: Sighted and Efficient Multi-Turn Attack with Autonomy
abstract: arXiv:2610.35743v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing jailbreak attackers fall into two classes: static planners fix their single- or multi-turn adversarial plans in advance, remaining simple but losing sight of the victim's replies, wasting turns and limiting transferability; interactive generators read each victim reply to generate the next-turn attack but require in-loop evaluators for success signals or hints, incurring substantial costs and inflated performance. Bridging this gap, we propose SEMA-Auto, a sighted and efficient multi-turn attacker with autonomy, interacting with the victim model and terminating the session by itself upon success. To stabilize its behaviors and boost its capabilities, SEMA-Auto is trained in two stages. Synthetic bootstrap tuning installs the notion of attack targets and conforming decisions by fine-tuning the base model with bootstrapped trajectories. Decision-supervised reinforcement learning then optimizes two objectives jointly yet separately

translated_title: SEMA-Auto：具备自主性的有感知且高效的多轮攻击
translated_abstract: 现有的越狱攻击方法分为两类：静态规划器预先固定其单轮或多轮对抗计划，虽然简单但无法感知受害者的回复，浪费轮次并限制了可迁移性；交互式生成器会读取受害者的每次回复以生成下一轮攻击，但需要循环内的评估器来提供成功信号或提示，导致高昂的成本和虚高的性能表现。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了SEMA-Auto，一个具有自主性的有感知且高效的多轮攻击器，它能够与受害模型交互，并在成功后自行终止会话。为了稳定其行为并提升其能力，SEMA-Auto分两个阶段进行训练。合成自举调优阶段通过使用自举轨迹对基础模型进行微调，植入攻击目标的概念和符合规范的决策。随后，决策监督强化学习阶段联合但分别地优化两个目标。
tldr: 提出SEMA-Auto，一种无需循环内评估器、能感知受害者回复并自主决定终止时机的多轮越狱攻击方法，通过合成自举调优和决策监督强化学习两阶段训练实现高效自主攻击。
en_tdlr: We propose SEMA-Auto, an autonomous multi-turn jailbreak attacker that perceives victim replies and self-terminates without costly in-loop evaluators, trained via synthetic bootstrap tuning and decision-supervised reinforcement learning.
